name: Ternary Bonsai 2 27B
description: Experimental native packed ternary Qwen decoder with the shipped Q8 image projector.
limitations: Experimental text and still-image support; TP=1 and one active request.
Text weights remain packed; the Q8 vision projector is expanded to BF16 at load.
Image prompts must fit the 2048-token single-prefill budget.
262K context, video, speculative decoding and general quality parity are not qualified.
Text decode uses CUDA graphs; image requests keep the eager MRoPE path.
